setup: One continuous 6-second shot in the flooded village chapel @SET-05 at dusk. Tomas @CAST-06 is centre-frame in extreme close-up; the single tall candle @PROP-04 in its brass holder and the rows of empty pews are revealed as the 85mm dolly pulls back.

beats.camera: 85 mm, extreme close-up on Tomas's face, eyes centred; the dolly begins its slow backward crawl.
beats.action: Tomas @CAST-06 stares straight into the lens; a fine tremor runs through his jaw and his eyes glisten as grief tightens the muscles around them.

beats.camera: Dolly continues pulling; frame widens to a medium close-up, shoulders and upper chest in view.
beats.action: His breath catches audibly, shoulders rising once under the coat; the brass holder of the candle @PROP-04 catches a glint of warm light at the bottom edge of frame.

beats.camera: Pull-out steadies; the front pew enters the lower third, ankle-deep dark water glistening between the pews.
beats.action: The candle @PROP-04 is now fully in frame, its single flame steady against the dusk; Tomas's gaze remains fixed on the lens, his lips parting slightly as if to speak but no sound comes.

beats.camera: Wider still; the shallow 85 mm depth of field softens the back rows into warm bokeh; the hole in the roof is visible above.
beats.action: Rows of empty wooden pews stretch into the chapel; candles on every sill cast small halos. Tomas @CAST-06 is a small, motionless figure, utterly alone in the space.

beats.camera: Hold on the full reveal; no further movement.
beats.action: The flooded chapel @SET-05 holds in frame. Tomas does not move. The candle flickers once; the dark water lies perfectly still. End.

sound: The low resonance of the single bell from S20 still fading over the water. A soft drip from the roof hole. The faint crackle and hush of the candle flame. No dialogue.
